title: Scope: Products with digital elements
description: Products with digital elements placed on the EU market must meet CRA obligations including secure-by-design, secure-by-default and timely updates.

title: Secure by design and secure by default
description: Manufacturers must design products to be secure throughout their lifecycle and ship them with secure default settings.

title: Vulnerability handling and updates
description: Manufacturers must have processes to handle vulnerabilities and provide timely security updates for an appropriate period.

title: Incident reporting
description: Reporting obligations for manufacturers and importers for certain cybersecurity incidents, with dates phased in according to the regulation.

title: Third-party assessment and CE marking
description: Some high-risk products require third-party assessment before market entry; compliant products will carry the CE mark.

title: Labelling and transparency
description: Manufacturers must provide transparent information about security functionality and maintenance periods to buyers.
